reason: This port has no stress table (data/stress/*.marisa, ~233k word forms — decoding it would dominate this package's gzipped size; see js/src/rules/morphology.ts's module comment). Every case below is jakanne (не/без -> ня/бяз) that needs GrammarDB's word stress to know the *next* word is stressed on its first syllable; the fallback both sides share (a stressed_initial_u stem, a monosyllable, or a word starting with ё) is exact for everything else. This is a known, deliberate, documented gap, not a bug — the same discipline conformance/known_failures.jsonl applies on the Python side.
